turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
We start with the verb, and words like usually come next. When the person is he, she or it, the verb gets -s or -es. So we say I get up, but my brother gets up.
Example: My brother usually gets up at seven. Brother is a he, so get becomes gets.
Now you. Correct the verb:
"She go to bed at ten."
